name: British Columbia additional property transfer tax for foreign buyers (20%)
description: Foreign nationals, foreign corporations and taxable trustees pay an extra 20% of fair market value on residential property in specified areas, on top of the general property transfer tax.

attributes.exemption_bc_pnp: Confirmed BC Provincial Nominee who is a foreign national, buying a principal residence, once; spouse not exempt.
